in_sanskrit.name: प्रदद्मन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who grants or bestows the gift of human life

in_marathi.name: Praduman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Praduman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pradhan-man, meaning the foremost man, the one who leads from the front, the one who is a gift from God.

in_bengali.name: Praduman
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's gift
in_bengali.long_meaning: Praduman একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Pradhan-man, meaning the foremost man, the one who leads from the front, the one who is a gift from God.
